Overview

Miami is a city in FL with a population of 455,924. Tropical paradise with Latin culture, no state income tax, and a growing finance hub. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 11a growing zone supports Very hot — tropical fruits, multiple growing cycles.
